page.layout: One title page, all text centred. Title block at top; a woodcut of an arch in a frame, with text above and on both sides, in the middle; imprint below. Handwriting and a shelf mark are not transcribed.

main_text.l: impietatum ac triplicis perfidiæ & periurii, breuis
explicatio, ex actis publicis Senatus Geneuensis
Earundem refutationes à doctissimis ætatis nostræ
Eiusdem Gentilis extremæ perfidiæ, & iusti supplicij de eo
quoniam lata est porta, & spatiosa via,

page.notes: Handwritten ink strikeout and inscription under the title block ("Sum. Ioan. Gassivi..."), and a handwritten date and name below the imprint: not transcribed as printed text. Shelf mark "Bc 3315" in pencil at the foot: not transcribed. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf: not transcribed. The woodcut's side texts are read along the frame: left "Introite per angustam portam,", top "quoniam lata est porta, & spatiosa via,", right "quæ abducit in exitium. Matt.7.13.". No page number or running head printed.
